title_structure: Individual Chanote title per villa — freehold or leasehold
location_blurb: Maduwan — the heart of the island. Quiet, green, close to everything. 5 min to Sri Thanu & Hin Kong beaches · 1 min walk to 7/11 & Tops Daily · 4 min to Arki Kids School · 6 min to Podium Gym · 7 min to Thong Sala (island centre). Not on the sea — a 5-minute drive.
payment: Five milestone payments of 20%, reservation → handover. 1-bed: flexible staged option (e.g. 30/15/20/10/20).
turnkey_included: Fitted kitchen — granite, gas hob, mixer
turnkey_note: Furniture and selected finishes are provided to a set allowance and can be upgraded. Covered carport is not included.
model_note: Buyer chooses a size tier and a design; developer builds on an available plot. Designs are customizable (pool size, house size, terrace, 1 / 1.5 / 2 storeys). Plot mappings below are EXAMPLES, not fixed assignments.

fx.note: SINGLE SOURCE for currency. Supersedes the old fx_thb_per_usd 32.5. Brochure v1/v2 were rendered at the earlier ฿32.5/$1 rate (USD ~1.8% higher, e.g. 1BR $107,700 vs $105,700) — reconcile on next brochure rebuild.

headline_metric_policy: Headline = built (indoor) area + plot size, both shown. Pool m2 and terrace m2 are named features, NEVER folded into built area.
hero_line: Design your villa — 1 to 4 bedrooms, single or two-storey, your pool, your terrace. From THB 3.5M, central Koh Phangan.

land.scarcity: 5 of 8 villas remaining — only 2 of the larger 211 m² plots left (availability as of June 2026)
land.garden_premium_policy: No garden premium on public assets — sales-conversation upsell only.
land.status_policy: Dated count is the honest urgency in print; do not re-bake per-plot SOLD/RESERVED badges into the masked masterplan image.
